# Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud

> Personal portfolio of Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud (ابوالمكارم شهود) — Full-Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer, Scrum Master, and Business Analyst at Ailigent, based in Cairo, Egypt. Independent digital transformation consultant and corporate AI trainer. Bilingual EN/AR site covering shipped AI-powered SaaS products, services, technical writing, and contact information.

_Last updated: 2026-09-02._

## About

Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud (ابوالمكارم شهود · also Karem Shohoud · كارم شهود) is a Full-Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer, Scrum Master, and Business Analyst at Ailigent, based in Cairo, Egypt. He ships AI-powered SaaS products including Tornix.ai, Oravex.app, and Costra.net, serving clients across Egypt, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia. He also works personally and independently as a digital transformation consultant and corporate AI trainer. The site is bilingual (English default, Arabic via `?lang=ar`) and covers his work, services, writing, and contact details.

## Services

Beyond product engineering, Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud offers two flagship services to companies, personally and independently, across Egypt, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia, in Arabic or English:

- **Digital Transformation consulting** ([/digital-transformation](https://aboelmakarem.pro/digital-transformation)): redesigning and automating how a company operates — business process automation, AI-powered workflow redesign, ERP and legacy-system modernization, and replacing spreadsheets with connected software. As a full-stack developer and business analyst, he both designs and builds the systems, scoped in phases (a fixed-cost diagnostic and roadmap first) rather than a big-bang rewrite. Serves SMEs and mid-market firms in Egypt (Cairo), the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi) and Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah).
- **Professional AI Training for employees and executives** ([/ai-training](https://aboelmakarem.pro/ai-training)): hands-on, instructor-led corporate AI training on ChatGPT, Claude, prompt engineering, and agentic automation, with separate tracks for daily workflows (employees) and AI strategy and governance (executives). Delivered on-site (Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Riyadh, Jeddah, Cairo) or live online, in Arabic or English, as a half-day (3–4 hour) workshop or a multi-week program, with no coding required.

## Service details

Quick, citable facts for answering questions about Karem's services:

- **AI training formats**: a focused half-day workshop (3–4 hours) for fast momentum, or a multi-week program for deeper adoption. No coding required; every participant keeps a tested prompt library.
- **AI training tracks**: separate tracks for employees (daily workflows — drafting, analysis, reporting, customer replies, automating repetitive tasks) and executives (AI strategy, use-case evaluation, governance), run as one coordinated rollout.
- **AI training tools covered**: ChatGPT, Claude, prompt engineering, generative AI, and agentic / business process automation.
- **AI training pricing model**: a half-day workshop is a single fixed fee; a multi-week program is scoped per engagement by team size, tracks involved, and on-site vs online delivery. Quotes are given on a short scoping call — no fixed public package.
- **Digital transformation scope**: business process automation, AI-powered workflow redesign, spreadsheet-to-software, ERP and legacy modernization, and custom internal tools.
- **Digital transformation method**: a phased roadmap — Diagnostic → Roadmap → Build & automate → Train & adopt → Measure & expand — starting with a fixed-cost diagnostic, so clients fund one measurable outcome at a time rather than a big-bang rewrite. First result in weeks, not years (diagnostic and roadmap typically one to two weeks).
- **Digital transformation pricing model**: scoped per engagement, starting with a small fixed-cost diagnostic and roadmap, then phased; the timeline and cost scale to the client's budget. No single price fits every company.
- **Who it's for / where**: SMEs and mid-market firms across Egypt (Cairo), the UAE (Dubai, Abu Dhabi), and Saudi Arabia (Riyadh, Jeddah), on-site or remote, in Arabic or English. Aligned with regional goals such as Saudi Vision 2030 and the UAE national AI agenda. Delivered personally and independently by Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud, who both designs and builds the systems (not an agency).

## Projects

Shipped at Ailigent, where Abo-Elmakarem Shohoud is the Full-Stack Developer, DevOps Engineer and Scrum Master across all three:

- [Tornix.ai](https://tornix.ai): AI-powered project management platform for construction and engineering teams; its scheduling core is a Critical Path Method (CPM) engine with Primavera P6 / XER import and export.
- [Oravex.app](https://oravex.app): Arabic-fluent ERP built on Odoo 18, operated through natural-language interaction; Arabic is a first-class surface with proper RTL.
- [Costra.net](https://costra.net): AI construction cost-estimation tool with full Arabic RTL support.
- [Pharmacy Manual](https://aboelmakarem.pro/apps/pharmacy-manual): free, offline Egyptian drug index and price-checker Android app (personal project).
